task: Upgrade Headlamp v0.42.0 to v0.46.0 and replace the APISIX login-injection and main-tab auth-return workarounds with Headlamp's built-in OIDC auto-login (#491 item 2). Scope of this change: repository chart/image/inventory/SBOM/docs/regression updates; live Gitea chart publish, bastion image mirror and GitOps push are done by the orchestrator after merge.

events.summary: Upgrade Headlamp from 0.42.0 to 0.46.0 across GitOps (headlamp.yaml), Phase 2 (08-3-security.sh), air-gap inventory/digests/SBOM and docs; enable config.oidc.autoLogin: true and config.oidc.externalSecret.hasScopes: true; remove the gateway HTML-injection routes (headlamp-login-autoredirect and headlamp-auth-return) and R286; add R288 (check-headlamp-autologin.py --mutation-verify). No live cluster mutations in this worker lane.

Headlamp v0.42.0 lacked built-in OIDC autoLogin and its main-tab /auth?cluster= return did not redirect, requiring two APISIX HTML-injection routes (headlamp-login-autoredirect and headlamp-auth-return). Upstream v0.46.0 (2026-10-15, PR #7071 and PR #5972) adds config.oidc.autoLogin (-oidc-auto-login, served as oidcAutoLogin in /config and consumed by AuthChooser with ?logout=true and sessionStorage oidc-login-attempted.<cluster> guards plus RP-initiated /encoded-clusters/<cluster>/oidc-logout) and completes non-popup main-tab logins in frontend/src/components/oidcauth/index.tsx via history.replace(returnUrl). Diffing helm template 0.42.0 vs 0.46.0 also showed chart >= 0.43.0 omits -oidc-scopes=$(OIDC_SCOPES) when externalSecret.enabled is true unless config.oidc.externalSecret.hasScopes: true is set.

Bumped Headlamp chart and main/initContainer image pins to 0.46.0/v0.46.0 across headlamp.yaml, 08-3-security.sh, images.txt, image-digests.tsv, check-sbom-inventory-completeness.py, VERSIONS.md, compatibility-matrix.md and READMEs; enabled config.oidc.autoLogin: true and config.oidc.externalSecret.hasScopes: true in both headlamp.yaml and 08-3-security.sh; removed headlamp-login-autoredirect, headlamp-auth-return, R286 and check-headlamp-autologin-route.py; added R288 (check-headlamp-autologin.py --mutation-verify) and updated SSO/lessons docs.
